text:
nina-peopleops: Hey @sam-eng-manager 1 prepping a compact 'first-week sprint' checklist to hand to Lee. Can you scan quickly? Plan is minimal so it's actionable day-by-day.

sam-eng-manager: Yep send it over. Make sure we include: monorepo access, API overview, at least one trivial bugfix to ship in week 1, and a 1:1 on goals. Also note Lee is PST.

nina-peopleops: Draft below. Short, copyable for calendar invites and Slack DM: 

```
Day 0 (preboard): IT request for hardware, KMS access form, add to #new-hires
Day 1: 10:00 welcome + CEO 15m intro, 11:00 team stand, 13:00 setup block (accounts + MDM), 15:00 quick tour of product + docs
Day 2: 09:30 API walkthrough (eng pairing), 14:00 repo access verification + clone test
Day 3: 10:00 shadow run in staging, 14:00 pick tiny bug / doc fix to ship
Day 4: 09:00 cross-team sync (product/design), 16:00 manager 1:1 (expectations + 30/60/90)
Day 5: 11:00 team retro on onboarding, 14:00 ship PR + celebrate
```

Tiny 30/60/90 to hand out: 

```
30d: fully booted dev env, merged 1 small PR, met key partners
60d: own a small feature, take code reviews in your area
90d: lead a post-deploy check or ship a perf/infra improvement
```

Who-to-ask quick mapping: hardware & MDM = @it-support, repo/CI perms = @eng-infra, security questions = @sec-ops, perks/HR = @people-ops.

sam-eng-manager: This is great. Two tweaks: move CEO intro to 11:00 so it's within overlap with EMEA, and add a line about timezone-friendly invites (default to 14:00 PST for pairing). Also I'll schedule the bug assignment for Wed afternoon.

lee-newhire: Thanks all! Quick check: I got the laptop email but not the VPN creds yet. Also 403 on repo clone. My timezone is PST (UTC-8).

it-support-bot: Hi Lee 1 Your laptop is in transit (ETA 3 business days). VPN creds email queued; if not received by EOD, reply "vpn help" and we'll escalate.

nina-peopleops: Lee 1 I escalated repo perms to @eng-infra with your GitHub handle. Moved pairing to 14:00 PST where possible. Welcome again 389

sam-eng-manager: I'll follow up on the repo 403 and confirm the Wed bug. Welcome aboard Lee 44b

lee-newhire: Great, appreciate it. See you Monday afternoon for setup. :)
